synthesis.body: lint-contract-item-alignment's stale-assertion rule — a criterion reworded while the plan assertions naming it stayed put — executes only when --since supplies a base revision. Without it every run prints '0 finding(s) ... 1 partial (rules with no input: stale-assertion (no --since))', which scans as green. Across three spec-review rounds that line was read past about ten times while the same defect was found by hand twice. Supplying --since against the pre-repair commit flagged seven criteria whose plan assertions had not followed their rewording. Treat any 'partial (rules with no input)' count as an un-run rule and supply its input, rather than reading the finding count alone.

title: A lint rule reported as 'partial' did not run, and the summary still reads as a pass
